content: STAGE: orient. GOAL: ground a new coupling mechanism in the actual Stage2/Stage3 pipeline before writing the idea. READ: listing of the ideation_5 workspace and nearby repo dirs. OBSERVED: (filling next). EVIDENCE: workspace paths. REASONING: need mechanics of RQ-VAE quantizer + Stage3 prefix model to place a behaviour*hyperbolic term in a shared pathway. OPEN: find quantizer file, SID layout, Stage3 protocol.

STAGE: answer. GOAL: 1 in-scope idea distinct from prior rounds, which all put behaviour+curvature in ASSIGNMENT/OT/fork/cone/shell/chart space and all probed INCONCLUSIVE. OBSERVED: free design position = the codebook ESTIMATOR (the update rule that produces the SID vocabulary), not the assignment cost. CHOSEN: poincare-frechet-successor-codebook -- replace RQ-VAE codebook update with a successor-weighted Riemannian Frechet step c_k <- exp_{c_k}(eta * sum_i w_i log_{c_k}(z_i)/sum_i w_i) in the kappa=-1 Poincare ball, with the same w_i in the commitment term; w_i=(indeg_v+1)/(n_v+2) from TRAIN-only directed session transitions, clipped [0.25,4] and batch-mean normalised. Geometry-off = identity exp/log + L2 + weighted EMA; behaviour-off = w=1; only the full coupled arm is trained. Cost ~5-10% Stage2 wall clock, no extra fwd/bwd. Leakage: train split only, table frozen before Stage3. FULL ANSWER is printed as the task response. OPEN: empirical risk only (slot collapse, popularity proxy, seed noise).
